name: Zipline
summary: Autonomous delivery company operating drone logistics networks.
overview: Zipline provides drone delivery services for medical and retail customers.
bull_case: Reliable autonomous delivery could transform urgent and last-mile logistics.
bear_case: Regulation, network economics, and high deployment costs can slow scale.

intelligence.description: Zipline designs, manufactures, and operates autonomous systems for medical, retail, and food delivery.
company: Zipline operates autonomous delivery networks that transport medical supplies, retail products, and food directly to customers.
The company said it had surpassed two million commercial deliveries when it announced more than $600 million of funding in January 2026.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Zipline is one of the most mature autonomous-delivery companies. Its delivery volume offers a rare operating proof point for drone logistics beyond pilot programs.

changed.text: Raised more than $600M and reported a $7.6B valuation.

takeaways: Zipline has demonstrated commercial delivery volume at scale.
Regulatory approvals and network economics determine its expansion pace.
The latest funding valued the company at $7.6B.
